Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR 
LUGS FOR WRIST WATCH CASE 



(Reaffirmed -2012 



1. Scope — Covers the details of the following two types of lugs and fitting dimensions of the 
spring bar for wrist watch case. 

Type A — With blind hole 
Type B — With through hole

3. Designation 

3.1 Lugs of Type A having distance between lugs 3=12 mm for metallic strap ( M ) shall be desig- 
nated as: 

Lug A 12 M- IS : 9641

3.2 Lugs of Type B having distance between lugs a = 14 mm and width of tug i« V6 mm for non-

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to wrist watch case. In the prepa- 
ration of this standard assistance has been derived from IN 8265 (Part 3 )-1976 Cases for watches; 
distance between horns and fitting dimensions for spring pins. Deutsches Institut Fur Normung. 



Printed at Prlntrade, New Delhi, India
